<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="ERD_Full" id="42Wz3G4lZ02xJ_vOp-wv"> <mxGraphModel dx="7715" dy="4146" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1100" pageHeight="850" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "erDiagram
 %% ==========================================
 %% INFRASTRUCTURE & SHARED FOUNDATION
 %% ==========================================
 regions ||--o{ towers : contains
 regions ||--o{ missions : covers
 users ||--o{ user_roles : assigned_to
 roles ||--o{ user_roles : defines

 %% ==========================================
 %% MF01: PLANNING & PRE-MISSION FEASIBILITY
 %% ==========================================
 missions ||--o| pre_mission_assessments : has_assessment
 missions ||--o{ mission_targets : targets
 towers ||--o{ mission_targets : inspected_in
 users ||--o{ pre_mission_assessments : evaluates

 %% ==========================================
 %% MF02: SCHEDULING & RESOURCE BOOKING
 %% ==========================================
 missions ||--o{ mission_assignments : assigns
 users ||--o{ mission_assignments : member_of
 missions ||--o{ resource_bookings : reserves
 users ||--o{ resource_bookings : booked_pilot
 uavs ||--o{ resource_bookings : booked_drone
 missions }o--o| uavs : assigned_drone
 uavs ||--o{ drone_technical_inspections : inspects
 drone_technical_inspections ||--o{ drone_technical_metrics : measures
 users ||--o{ drone_technical_inspections : inspected_by

 %% ==========================================
 %% MF03: FIELD EXECUTION & INGESTION
 %% ==========================================
 missions ||--o{ mission_check_ins : checks_in
 users ||--o{ mission_check_ins : attendee
 missions ||--o{ drone_handovers : hands_over
 uavs ||--o{ drone_handovers : handed_drone
 users ||--o{ drone_handovers : handed_by
 users ||--o{ drone_handovers : received_by
 missions ||--o{ mission_flight_logs : logs_telemetry
 missions ||--o{ incident_reports : reports
 towers ||--o{ incident_reports : incident_at
 users ||--o{ incident_reports : reported_by
 missions ||--o{ inspection_media : captures
 towers ||--o{ inspection_media : depicts
 users ||--o{ inspection_media : uploaded_by

 %% ==========================================
 %% MF04: AI ANALYSIS & DEFECT VALIDATION
 %% ==========================================
 inspection_media ||--o{ ai_analysis_requests : triggers
 inspection_media ||--o{ detected_anomalies : reveals
 missions ||--o{ ai_analysis_requests : scoped_to
 towers ||--o{ detected_anomalies : located_at
 defect_categories ||--o{ detected_anomalies : categorizes
 users ||--o{ detected_anomalies : reviewed_by

 %% ==========================================
 %% MF04: EMERGENCY ALERTS & MAINTENANCE
 %% ==========================================
 detected_anomalies ||--o{ emergency_alerts : triggers
 emergency_alerts ||--o{ alert_escalations : escalates
 users ||--o{ emergency_alerts : resolved_by
 users ||--o{ alert_escalations : escalated_to
 detected_anomalies ||--o{ maintenance_tickets : initiates
 towers ||--o{ maintenance_tickets : repair_target
 users ||--o{ maintenance_tickets : managed_by
 users ||--o{ maintenance_tickets : assigned_technician
 maintenance_tickets ||--o{ maintenance_proofs : verifies
 users ||--o{ maintenance_proofs : uploaded_by
 towers ||--o{ tower_condition_histories : tracks_condition

 %% ==========================================
 %% AUDITING & NOTIFICATIONS
 %% ==========================================
 missions ||--o{ audit_logs : audit_trail
 users ||--o{ audit_logs : acted_by
 users ||--o{ notifications : receives

 %% ==========================================
 %% ENTITY DEFINITIONS
 %% ==========================================
 regions {
 uuid id PK
 varchar code UK
 varchar name
 geometry geom
 }

 towers {
 uuid id PK
 uuid region_id FK
 varchar tower_code UK
 varchar line_code
 varchar voltage
 varchar pole_type
 varchar address
 geometry geom
 varchar risk_level
 int active_defects_count
 timestamptz last_inspected_at
 }

 users {
 uuid id PK
 varchar username UK
 varchar email UK
 varchar full_name
 varchar phone
 boolean is_active
 }

 roles {
 int id PK
 varchar role_name UK
 varchar description
 }

 user_roles {
 uuid user_id PK,FK
 int role_id PK,FK
 timestamptz assigned_at
 }

 uavs {
 uuid id PK
 varchar uav_code UK
 varchar name
 varchar model
 varchar serial_number UK
 varchar status
 varchar operational_status
 varchar technical_health
 float battery_level
 float total_flight_hours
 geometry current_location
 uint version
 }

 missions {
 uuid id PK
 varchar mission_code UK
 varchar title
 varchar status
 int priority
 varchar objective
 timestamptz planned_start
 timestamptz planned_end
 timestamptz actual_start
 timestamptz actual_end
 uuid manager_id FK
 uuid inspector_id FK
 uuid uav_id FK
 uuid region_id FK
 geometry boundary
 text manager_instructions
 timestamptz confirmation_deadline
 uint version
 }

 pre_mission_assessments {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id UK,FK
 uuid manager_id FK
 varchar status
 varchar site_feasibility
 varchar weather_suitability
 varchar airspace_clearance
 varchar resource_readiness
 jsonb findings
 geometry proposed_boundary
 timestamptz evaluated_at
 }

 mission_targets {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id FK
 uuid tower_id FK
 int sequence_order
 varchar inspection_status
 timestamptz inspected_at
 }

 mission_assignments {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id FK
 uuid user_id FK
 varchar assignment_role
 boolean is_required
 varchar status
 varchar response_status
 timestamptz assigned_at
 timestamptz responded_at
 text response_reason
 uint version
 }

 resource_bookings {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id FK
 uuid user_id FK
 uuid drone_id FK
 timestamptz start_at
 timestamptz end_at
 varchar status
 }

 drone_technical_inspections {
 uuid id PK
 uuid drone_id FK
 uuid technician_user_id FK
 varchar status
 varchar health
 timestamptz started_at
 timestamptz completed_at
 timestamptz valid_until
 jsonb raw_snapshot
 text notes
 }

 drone_technical_metrics {
 uuid id PK
 uuid inspection_id FK
 varchar metric_code
 varchar subsystem
 numeric numeric_value
 boolean passed
 boolean is_critical
 varchar unit
 }

 mission_check_ins {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id FK
 uuid user_id FK
 geometry check_in_location
 timestamptz checked_in_at
 varchar status
 }

 drone_handovers {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id FK
 uuid drone_id FK
 uuid handed_over_by FK
 uuid received_by FK
 timestamptz received_at
 jsonb initial_checklist
 varchar status
 timestamptz returned_at
 jsonb return_checklist
 }

 mission_flight_logs {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id FK
 jsonb gps_track
 float min_battery_recorded
 float max_altitude_m
 int flight_duration_seconds
 varchar connection_status
 timestamptz recorded_at
 uuid created_by
 }

 incident_reports {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id FK
 uuid reported_by FK
 uuid tower_id FK
 varchar incident_type
 varchar severity
 text description
 varchar file_url
 varchar status
 timestamptz reported_at
 }

 inspection_media {
 uuid id PK
 uuid mission_id FK
 uuid tower_id FK
 uuid uploaded_by FK
 geometry capture_location
 varchar media_type
 varchar file_url
 varchar ai_source
 varchar validation_status
 timestamptz captured_at
 }

 ai_analysis_requests {
 uuid id PK
 uuid media_id FK
 uuid mission_id FK
 uuid tower_id FK
 uuid uploaded_by FK
 uuid source_event_id
 varchar media_type
 varchar status
 jsonb result
 timestamptz completed_at
 timestamptz created_at
 }

 defect_categories {
 int id PK
 varchar category_code UK
 varchar name
 varchar default_severity
 text description
 boolean is_active
 }

 detected_anomalies {
 uuid id PK
 uuid media_id FK
 uuid tower_id FK
 int category_id FK
 uuid analyst_id FK
 jsonb bounding_box
 float confidence_score
 varchar validation_status
 jsonb analyst_feedback
 timestamptz validated_at
 varchar crop_url
 varchar image_url
 jsonb gps
 varchar ai_source
 }

 emergency_alerts {
 uuid id PK
 uuid anomaly_id FK
 uuid tower_id FK
 uuid mission_id FK
 varchar status
 varchar priority
 timestamptz triggered_at
 timestamptz resolved_at
 uuid reviewed_by_user_id FK
 text notes
 }

 alert_escalations {
 uuid id PK
 uuid alert_id FK
 uuid escalated_by FK
 uuid escalated_to FK
 int escalation_level
 text reason
 timestamptz escalated_at
 }

 maintenance_tickets {
 uuid id PK
 varchar ticket_code UK
 uuid anomaly_id FK
 uuid tower_id FK
 uuid manager_id FK
 uuid technician_id FK
 varchar status
 varchar priority
 text description
 timestamptz due_date
 timestamptz assigned_at
 timestamptz started_at
 timestamptz resolved_at
 }

 maintenance_proofs {
 uuid id PK
 uuid ticket_id FK
 varchar proof_type
 varchar file_url
 uuid uploaded_by FK
 timestamptz uploaded_at
 }

 tower_condition_histories {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tower_id FK
 varchar risk_level
 int active_defects_count
 timestamptz assessed_at
 }

 notifications {
 uuid id PK
 uuid user_id FK
 varchar type
 varchar reference_type
 uuid reference_id
 varchar title
 text body
 boolean is_read
 timestamptz sent_at
 }

 audit_logs {
 uuid id PK
 uuid user_id FK
 varchar table_name
 uuid record_id
 varchar action_type
 jsonb old_values
 jsonb new_values
 timestamptz created_at
 }
